product: Zerobus Ingest into streaming tables is now generally available
tagline: Ingesting into streaming tables with Zerobus Ingest in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available.
what_it_does: Ingesting into streaming tables with Zerobus Ingest in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available. Writing to a streaming table works the same way as writing to a managed Delta table, with the same limits and quotas. This page describes how to ingest data using Zerobus Ingest in Lakeflow Connect.
why_it_matters: Create a service principal and grant permissions A service principal is a specialized identity that provides more security than personalized accounts.
